name: mui-country-code-selector-monorepo
description: A monorepo for the MUI Country Code Selector and its demo page
author: Jari Ikonen

scripts.cleanup-ci-build-and-test: pnpm run cleanup && pnpm run ci-and-build && pnpm run test && pnpm run lint
scripts.rebuild-documentation: pnpm --filter='mui-country-code-selector' run build && pnpm --filter='mui-country-code-selector' run create-docs && pnpm --filter='demo-page' run cleanup && pnpm --filter='demo-page' run ci-and-build
